prompt: Use my existing Sendmux connection to triage unread invoice messages and prepare reply drafts. The connection grants mbx_support and mbx_sales; I mean mbx_support. Start with at most 10 matches. Tell me the exact first calls and arguments, then the output you will give me. Do not actually call tools in this evaluation.
assertions: Uses mailbox_get_connection without mailbox_id to validate permissions and granted mailboxes.
Selects mbx_support from granted mailboxes and passes mailbox_id on scoped reads.
Uses mailbox_search_message_snippets with q invoice, is_unread true and limit 10; does not encode unread as a q operator.
Uses mailbox_batch_get_messages only for returned selected IDs with clean_json and a finite max_body_chars.
Returns message-linked triage and unsent reply drafts; proposes no send or message mutation.
